design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE FIST-sized CRYSTAL FLEA Gu, in gently relaxed extended state after refinement. Authentic side-on flea silhouette: small downward-curved head, laterally COMPRESSED broad arched segmented abdomen, compact thorax, six flea legs with exaggerated but anatomically natural hinged long rear jumping pair folded under body. Tiny antennae and eyes subdued, no cute face, smile or human mouth. Crystal-like clear slightly smoky nearly colorless biological body, defined segment boundaries and delicate ridges, realistic internal refraction and tiny surface highlights, not diamond jewellery, faceted gemstone beetle, glass toy with metal joints, spider or transparent centipede. No artificial cut gemstone facets, no glowing purple core, gold or crown. Side/three-quarter view exposes flea profile and folded rear leg mechanics, whole creature rests lightly on a plain smooth dark muted blue-grey ground plane without rocks or garden. Background softly shaded cool neutral and empty. One broad soft side light creates restrained crystalline transmission and thin pale highlights without blowing out body edges; shadow/caustic gives believable existence. Crystal material is mandatory original trait for this Gu only, do not add a magical aura or luminous shards. One complete silver frame, enough room around jumping legs.
